title: Integrating Semantic Web Technologies and Large Language Models: Ontologies and LLMs for Medication and Anaphylaxis Detection

live_model.evidence: For the experiments, gpt-4 Turbo models run using OpenAI's cloud and llama3-70b, llama3-8b, and gemma-7b models used the Groq Cloud (OntoDrug chapter); Table 2 row 'gpt-4 turbo 0.974 1.000 0.987'

prompt.location: Anaphylaxis chapter: final prompt described as five requested items with JSON output; medication prompt not printed

claim.metric: F1-score for medication recognition in prescriptions

data.source: 203 prescriptions sampled from 3,761 and 150 EMRs from Hospital Sirio-Libanes; not public

notes: Master's dissertation (USP) bundling the WebMedia 2024 OntoDrug paper (W4403389951) and an anaphylaxis-detection study; no model version string beyond 'gpt-4 Turbo'.
